messages:
vince: Onboarding note: brought up hf/aphelion9b with our new static int4 pack. Short prompts ok, but long summaries (~2k+) start repeating clauses and inventing facts. kv-resume looks unstable when we prepend system messages.

vince: reproducer on ded-4:
```bash
./run_smoke --model aphelion9b --quant static-int4 --prompts tests/longs.txt --max-tokens 4096 --warmup 1
```

leigh: did you preserve upstream token normalization? Some exporters keep U+200B/soft-hyphen which shifts merged token ids and aligns repeats to word boundaries.

vince: we ran with `--preserve-norm` to match upstream. I tested a quick shim: `text = text.replace('\u200B','')` before encode -> repeat frequency dropped a lot.

cheng: sounds like tokenizer id shift is primary. Also ran `rotary-check` and found two heads with tiny fractional phase offsets:
```
head=4 offset=+0.0625
head=11 offset=-0.03125
```
Could be quant pack byte alignment or proj-order conversion noise.

sanjay: KV warmup masks symptoms: `--kvmode=warm` reduces loops ~60% but doesn't entirely fix. Plan: 1) bake converter shim (strip zero-width + NFKC) and reconvert, 2) rerun with forced warmup and collect kv checksums, 3) if residual, rebuild pack with `per_head_scale=true` and diff per-head checksums.

triage-bot: Created ticket RH-2991: "aphelion9b int4: tokenmap zero-width offsets + kv-resume drift + fractional rotary head offsets" assigned eng-ml. https://redwood.example/issue/RH-2991 :white_check_mark:

vince: I'll push converter patch to `aphelion/tokenfix-nfkc` and post bench logs when complete. Drop proj/kv checksums here if you see low-order byte diffs.
